prior_accepted_source_identity.authority: The bound current_plan_review contains these prior accepted hashes; it does not approve the changed current bytes
prior_accepted_source_identity.verification: Reversed only the two installer hunks and the test additions/expected-stage change in memory. Both reconstructed complete files hash exactly to the prior pins. Printed and reviewed unified diffs; no old source artifact was written or modified.

saved_attempt_outcome.receipt_conformance: All nine saved records match the old stage vocabulary and first audit target: reservation, rename/detach/create intentions, replacement failure, owned-removal/name/network-restoration intentions, and final configuration/exact-baseline checks true. saved_attempt_outcome.actual_failure_cause: UNVERIFIED: the old replacement stage covers creation, subsequent inventory/metadata checks and source verification. Neither the receipt nor post-rollback snapshots identify the failed operation or predicate.

current_v3_baseline_rollback_evidence.comparison: Direct first == second equality; each capture has seven unique names and IDs, and its name-keyed complete snapshot records equal all seven current reviewed-plan baseline records without field projection or value normalization
current_v3_baseline_rollback_evidence.audit_baseline: The current v3 baseline already has audit-log networks=[''] and configured_only provenance. Those exact values remain in both saved post captures. This is not acceptance of earlier historical network restoration.
current_v3_baseline_rollback_evidence.limit: Retained selected sanitized snapshots, not an independently repeated daemon inventory, an atomic/current live guarantee, effective connectivity proof, full raw daemon-payload equality or storage-content verification

diagnostics_source_review.exact_delta: Only replacement predicate extraction plus fixed boolean receipt before assertion/recovery, and finite create/replacement_inventory/replacement_checks/source_verification stages with replacement reset between applications. Twelve regression cases added and one expected create-stage value updated.
diagnostics_source_review.predicate_equivalence: For present validated Snapshot records, present/new_identity/created/never_started/zero_restarts/restart_disabled/image_matches/attempt_matches/metadata_matches/network_ids_match are the same prior conjunction. Configured metadata/networks are selected only when bindings exist, otherwise legacy metadata/networks. Missing row returns {'present': false} and still rejects. Final validation delegates to the same predicates.
diagnostics_source_review.receipt_and_failure_order: Only fixed keys and booleans enter replacement_checks. Receipt is written before asserting all predicates, before source verification and before rollback. A diagnostic write exception still enters the unchanged failure/finally recovery path; the existing bounded receipt writer and deadlines remain in effect.
diagnostics_source_review.unchanged_surfaces: No Plan/policy/schema/network projection, backend command, source-verification criterion, runtime/startup behavior, ownership/recovery guard, storage gate, deadline or authorization change in the exact diff
diagnostics_source_review.remaining_source_risk: The new bounded receipt call adds fallible I/O and consumes the existing operation budget; fail-closed recovery is intentional, not a guarantee of successful installation or recovery under every host failure.

artifact_and_predicate_probe.guards: Python audit hook denied process/socket operations and write opens; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 and -B; only inert definitions and synthetic backends evaluated
